name: gestalt
description: Survey, compose and sequence your agent harness into one lean way of working.

interface.shortDescription: Decides what your harness runs, and in what order.
interface.longDescription: Gestalt surveys the plugins, skills, connectors and hooks you have, measures what they cost in always-on context, interviews you about your goals and data, and compiles a lean way of working: an ordered flow (orient, intend, plan, make, check, record), a short managed block for AGENTS.md, worker definitions for focused sub-agents, kitctl loadouts, and a three-prompt taste test. NOTE: Codex runs the skills; the compiled block is advisory there, and Codex custom-agent fields are emitted as unverified.
defaultPrompt: Set up my way of working
Trim my harness — what am I paying for that never fires?
Give me a taste test for my setup
